items.q: What is the main difference between Standard and RAW ECN accounts?
items.a: The standard account uses all-in, zero-commission pricing with slightly higher spreads; RAW ECN offers lower raw spreads but charges a fixed commission per lot. This is an illustrative summary; actual conditions follow official announcements.

items.q: Can I try a free demo account first?
items.a: We plan to offer a demo account so you can get familiar with the platform in a risk-free environment. Availability and details will be announced separately.

items.q: Can I use automated (EA) strategies on the platform?

items.q: What is the maximum leverage, and can it be adjusted?
items.a: Account leverage is illustrative (e.g. up to 1:500, cent account up to 1:1000); actual leverage and any adjustments follow HATC's official announcements. Leverage amplifies both gains and losses — assess carefully.

faq.heading: Common trading-platform questions
faq.subheading: Quick answers about our trading platforms, features and account management.

items.q: What types of trading platforms does HATC offer?
items.a: HATC supports the widely used MetaTrader 5 (MT5), and also provides the HATC app built for mobile devices as well as the install-free HATC web trader you can use straight from your browser.

items.q: What is the difference between MT5 and HATC's own app?
items.a: MetaTrader 5 is a world-standard professional terminal with a full feature set and automated-trading support; the HATC app and web trader focus on ease of use for quick market monitoring and account management. Choose whichever suits your habits.

items.q: Can I try the platforms with a demo account first?
items.a: We plan to offer demo accounts so you can get familiar with the platforms in a risk-free environment; availability and details will be announced separately.

items.q: Do the platforms support automated (EA) trading?
items.a: MetaTrader 5 supports Expert Advisors (EAs) and automated trading scripts, suited to those with algorithmic trading needs.

items.q: What can I trade on HATC's platforms?
items.a: Backed by our AA-category Hong Kong Gold Exchange membership, HATC offers precious-metals products such as Loco London Gold and Silver; for detailed trading conditions please see the trading-conditions page or contact client support.

items.q: Are my funds safe on the platform?
items.a: Client funds are held in a designated custodial trust account, strictly segregated from the company's operating funds; all business follows the Hong Kong Gold Exchange compliance rules.

items.q: Are the market quotes on the platform real-time?
items.a: The platforms provide real-time market quotes; the actual dealt price follows the platform's live quote at the time.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about gold trading, platform technology and security & compliance. For anything else, feel free to contact our support team.

q1.q: How do I open a trading account with HATC?
q1.a: Opening an account is simple. Click “Open account” at the top right, fill in your basic details and upload identity and address documents as instructed; once verified, you'll receive an MT5 trading account. Our client-support team is happy to help if needed.

q2.q: What gold trading products does HATC offer?
q2.a: We mainly offer internationally connected spot “Loco London Gold (XAU/USD)” trading, together with “kilobar” trading that meets Hong Kong physical standards — letting you flexibly allocate both physical and price-based gold assets.

q3.a: Loco London Gold is the common term for international spot gold trading. Priced in US dollars, it offers near-24-hour two-way trading and high liquidity, and is a widely used tool for gold allocation.

q4.q: How do I use the MT5 platform?
q4.a: HATC uses the industry-standard MetaTrader 5 platform, available on desktop, web and mobile. We provide platform tutorials and operating guidance to help you install, log in and place orders smoothly.

q5.q: How do deposits and withdrawals work?
q5.a: Client funds are held in a designated custodial trust account, strictly segregated from the company's operating funds. For the specific deposit and withdrawal methods and process, please follow the platform guidance after opening an account, or contact our client-support team for details.

q6.a: Loco London Gold generally trades near 24 hours from Monday to Friday (subject to daylight-saving adjustments), helping investors take part across major global market sessions. Actual sessions follow the trading platform's announcements.
